title: 应用文的语域
goal: 能根据读者选择称呼、结束语和请求表达。

points.label: 按读者身份选择称呼和结束语
选择与交际关系一致的请求表达

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）：课表
sources.used: 应用文语域的内容与知识点

body.p: 语域要符合读者身份和交际关系。写给熟悉的同学，可以用名字称呼，请求也可以直接一些。初次联系教师或机构，称呼和请求要更正式。

body.box:
Hi Mei, can you check the poster?
Dear Professor Liu, could you check the poster?

body.p: 两句都请求检查海报。第一句适合熟悉的同学，第二句适合初次联系的教师。称呼、正文和结束语的语域要一致。

cards.title: 称呼与结束语
rows: 用名字称呼，署名写信人。
Dear Professor Liu, … Best regards, Li Hua
初次联系用职称和姓氏。
Dear Ms. Brown, … Kind regards, Li Hua
对方署名用什么称谓，回信就用什么。
Dear Admissions Team, … Yours sincerely, Li Hua

cards.title: 请求表达：资料
rows: Can you send me the notes?
Could you send me the notes?

cards.title: 请求表达：安排
rows: Would it be possible to move the meeting?
Would it be possible to collect it later?
I would be grateful if you could review my draft.

cards.title: 请求表达：协作
rows: Can you look at the list?

cards.title: 语域的一致性
rows: Dear Professor Wu, Send me the notes now.
Dear Professor Wu, could you send me the notes?
Hi Yan, I hereby submit a formal request for the notes.
Hi Yan, can you send me the notes?
Hey buddy, could you confirm the date?
Dear Admissions Team, could you confirm the date?
Dear Professor Wu, … Best regards, Professor Wu
Dear Professor Wu, … Best regards, Li Hua

groups.text: 假定李华首次给教师 Professor Chen 写信，请她确认讲座日期。

items.stem: Which greeting and signature fit the situation?
options: Dear Professor Chen, … Best regards, Li Hua
Dear Li Hua, … Best regards, Professor Chen
Hi Chen, … Best, Professor Chen
Hi Li Hua, … Best, Professor Chen
items.why: 读者是 Professor Chen，署名是写信人 Li Hua，第一项符合这一关系。

items.stem: Which request is suitable for a first message?
options: Confirm the lecture date immediately.
Could you confirm the lecture date?
The lecture date has been confirmed.
Could you tell me the lecture topic?
items.why: 李华要请教师确认讲座日期。第二项用 Could you 礼貌地提出这一请求；第四项同样礼貌，但问的是讲座主题。

groups.text: 假定李华给熟悉的同学 Ben 写信，请他发来活动照片。

items.stem: Which opening and closing suit the reader?
options: Dear Li Hua, … Best, Ben
Dear Photos Team, … Yours sincerely, Ben
Hi Ben, … Best, Li Hua
Hi Li Hua, … Best, Ben
items.why: 李华写信给熟悉的同学 Ben。称呼写读者 Ben，署名写写信人 Li Hua，即第三项。第四项把两人颠倒了。

options: Can you check the photos I sent you?
Would you review the photos for me?
I hereby request the activity photos.
Can you send me the activity photos?
items.why: 李华要请熟悉的同学发来活动照片。第四项用同学间自然的 Can you 提出这一请求；第三项对熟悉的同学过于正式。

items.stem: A student politely asks an office to check a registration.
items.why: Could you please check 是礼貌请求，check 后接核对的内容。

items.stem: A student closes a first letter to a teacher who has offered advice.
items.why: Thank you for your helpful advice 适合作为致谢结束语。

groups.text: 假定李华首次联系教师 Dr. Wang，请她提供讲座资料。

items.stem: Which greeting and signature fit the relationship?
options: Dear Dr. Wang, … Best regards, Li Hua
Dear Li Hua, … Best regards, Dr. Wang
Hi Wang, … Best, Dr. Wang
Dear Dr. Li, … Best regards, Wang
items.why: 首次联系教师用 Dr. Wang 称呼，Li Hua 是署名。

items.stem: Which sentence requests the materials politely?
options: The lecture materials have already arrived.
Could you send me the lecture materials?
Send me the lecture materials right now.
Could you tell me when the lecture starts?
items.why: 李华要请教师提供讲座资料。第二项用 Could you 礼貌地请对方发送资料；第四项问的是讲座时间。

groups.text: 假定李华联系熟悉的同学 Amy，请她核对旅行日期。

items.stem: Which opening and closing fit this message?
options: Dear Li Hua, … Best, Amy
Dear Travel Office, … Best, Amy
Hi Amy, … Best, Li Hua
Hi Li Hua, … Best, Amy
items.why: Amy 是熟悉的同学，也是收件人，称呼用 Hi Amy。Li Hua 是写信人，放在结尾，即第三项。

items.stem: Which request fits the task and relationship?
options: Can you change the travel date?
Could you choose a travel date?
I hereby request verification of the travel date.
Can you check the travel date?
items.why: 李华要请熟悉的同学 Amy 核对旅行日期。第四项用 Can you 直接提出这一请求；第一项把核对换成了更改。

items.stem: A student politely asks an institution for a schedule.
items.why: Could you please send 是礼貌请求，后接收取者及资料。

items.stem: A student thanks a teacher for reviewing a proposal.
items.why: for 后用 reviewing，句子适合作为致谢结束语。

items.stem: A student asks an office whether a meeting can be moved.
items.why: Would it be possible to 后接动词原形，礼貌询问安排是否可行。

items.stem: A student thanks the admissions team for its reply.
items.why: Thank you for your prompt reply 是适合机构通信的致谢结束语。
